interpretation: The seed-7919 200-floor run is a prefix of the formal 400-floor policy, not an independent additional journey.
All 508 deep positive-retaliation captures in that prefix had returned to full HP after settlement, so gross retaliation alone was insufficient to select active survival states.

The luck-vitality priority run reached floor 200 but did not complete the target within the simulator decision budget. Its long 77172-roll duration is a weak-offense strategy observation, not evidence of a broken combat rule.
Neither zero deaths nor the budget stop establishes desired difficulty, an error, or a human win rate.
